live.name: Chaka AI
live.summary: A high-performance humanoid multimodal AI platform with real-time voice interaction, emotional intelligence, advanced research ability and an episodic memory system.

sections.title: Executive summary & vision
sections.body: Chaka is an autonomous multimodal intelligence designed to serve as the ultimate personal assistant. Built by Emmanuel Ezinna Nweke (Templeton) at Jomiez Innovation, Chaka represents a leap toward emotional intelligence in AI, combining real-time voice interaction with a sophisticated tool-use system. Her personality is expressive and professional, designed to assist, research, and evolve alongside her users.

sections.title: Technical infrastructure
sections.body: The backend is a Node.js/Express application optimised for “warm performance”: an aggressive warm-up pipeline, including DNS pre-warming and library pre-initialisation, shaves milliseconds off external requests. The stack uses Turso (SQLite) for low-latency storage and Firebase Admin for secure authentication.

points.title: Real-time interaction
points.body: Gemini 2.5 Flash native audio for low-latency voice and visual streaming over WebSocket proxies.

points.title: Reasoning & vision
points.body: Gemini 2.0 Flash for general chat logic and deep multimodal input analysis.

points.title: Creative tools
points.body: High-fidelity image synthesis through Vertex AI (Imagen 3) and near-perfect transcription with OpenAI Whisper.

points.title: Key management
points.body: A dedicated ApiKeyManager rotates search, text and multimodal keys automatically to prevent interruptions.

sections.title: Frontend & UI/UX
sections.body: The “Neon HUD” interface is built on glassmorphism and high-aesthetic performance, with GSAP-driven micro-animations and an interactive face visualiser featuring gaze tracking, randomised blinking and emotional state rendering. Hybrid RAG orchestration offloads vector math to background Web Workers, keeping the UI at a consistent 60fps.

sections.title: The memory system
sections.body: Chaka builds a cognitive model of her users through a tiered memory system. Episodic memories log individual moments with associated emotions, while semantic memory distils them into a permanent identity profile. A background “Reflection” process consolidates memories to prevent bloat, so the AI can keep long-term goals and unfinished “open loops” for proactive interaction.

points.title: VideoAgent
points.body: Scene-by-scene visual and audio analysis of video content using yt-dlp and Gemini Flash.

points.title: Deep research
points.body: A tiered search system using Serper, Tavily and Firecrawl to extract research-ready data from complex or bot-shielded websites.

points.title: Silent execution
points.body: In Live Mode, Chaka runs tools silently to mimic human thought patterns rather than command-line feedback.

live.name: Chaka WAP
live.summary: A multimodal, local-first AI engine that joins WhatsApp conversations as a human-like participant, with dynamic style learning and a robust failover architecture.

sections.title: Project overview & architecture
sections.body: Chaka WAP is an advanced AI engine designed to operate autonomously on WhatsApp. Unlike traditional bots, it uses a Dynamic Style Learning Engine to mirror the conversational style, slang and brevity of the person it's talking to. The system runs on a decoupled architecture: a WhatsApp Web bridge, a local SQLite memory engine and a multi-LLM orchestrator.

points.title: Backend
points.body: Node.js with @whiskeysockets/baileys for the WhatsApp socket protocol.

points.title: Database
points.body: Local SQLite for fast, encrypted storage of chat logs and binary vector embeddings.

points.title: AI brain
points.body: Gemini 2.5 Flash for reasoning and Gemini 1.5 Flash for vision.

points.title: Local memory
points.body: @xenova/transformers runs locally to generate 384-dimensional vectors for private, cost-free RAG.

points.title: Admin UI
points.body: A real-time dashboard in Vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS and Socket.io for live telemetry and log monitoring.

sections.title: Memory logic & style learning
sections.body: Chaka remembers the whole relationship: an ingestion pipeline saves message embeddings as binary BLOBs in SQLite, and every reply runs a cosine-similarity search to pull relevant history into context. The engine also analyses a user's last 5–8 messages to mirror their syntax, capitalisation and use of Nigerian Pidgin.

sections.title: Vision & failover
sections.body: The system is fully multimodal, intercepting media to provide “occasion inference”: working out why a photo was sent from the chat so far. To stay online, an Ironclad Routing Orchestrator rotates through model versions and API keys whenever rate limits are hit.

points.title: Storage
points.body: Migrated from Firebase to local SQLite to escape document size limits and latency.

points.title: Embeddings
points.body: Replaced cloud embedding APIs with local transformers to remove API costs and improve privacy.

points.title: Data handling
points.body: Moved from string vectors to binary BLOBs, shrinking the database and speeding up reads 10x.

points.title: UI fluidity
points.body: Flex-based layouts let the admin dashboard scale from 4K monitors down to phones.

items.a: It analyses their last 5–8 messages and mirrors their syntax, capitalisation and use of Nigerian Pidgin.

children.text: Good software and AI act as force multipliers, freeing teams from tedious manual work so they can focus on strategy, creative problem-solving and sustainable growth.
Technology is at its best when it becomes an intuitive extension of human capability.
Beyond automation

We believe human-centred design is the only sustainable way to build digital tools. Instead of black boxes, we design transparent, high-performance interfaces that give teams real leverage and full control.
Intelligent core:
Fast querying and cross-referencing that surface the right insight to the right person.
Process automation:
Automating syncs, data entry and repetitive workflows.

Designing for speed and trust
People only rely on systems they trust. We build in clear logging, readable summaries of automated actions and feedback loops so teams can inspect and tune their tools continuously.
The return on performance
Remove repetitive busywork and teams move faster and enjoy the work more. Unified interfaces that bring critical data together turn engineering quality into a lasting business advantage.

live.title: The Modern Cloud: Why Clean Architecture Is the Future of Scale
live.excerpt: How private infrastructure and clean architecture let businesses scale without compromise.

children.text: As security demands increase and threats evolve, sending sensitive proprietary data to unvetted cloud systems carries real risk. Forward-thinking companies are adopting dedicated, private infrastructure to protect their digital assets and core business logic.
Data sovereignty is a strategic fortress protecting the unique intellectual property of your brand.
The shift toward private systems

For years, modern software meant compromising on data ownership. We deploy high-performance applications directly into your own cloud environments, so customer data, code and business intelligence stay under your control.
Pillars of robust tech
Dedicated hosting:
Deploying stacks on private VPCs and servers.
High performance:
Optimised local pipelines that keep pace with the cloud.
Isolated pipelines:
Production databases with no public exposure.
Distributed architecture

Modular services let systems synchronise data across regional servers without creating single points of failure: code runs close to the user, only encrypted payloads move between nodes, and confidential records stay in secure databases.
Security as an advantage
Privacy and compliance are foundational. By designing privacy into every architecture, we turn rigorous standards into an advantage and build lasting trust with your users.
Future-proofing your systems

The future of software is fast, responsive and intelligent. Jomiez delivers end-to-end engineering and custom AI integrations that help ambitious companies scale with confidence, privacy and full architectural ownership.

live.author: Templeton

live.title: Scalable Systems: Modernizing Legacy Stacks with Next-Gen Tech
live.excerpt: A practical guide to integrating custom software and AI into existing business environments.

children.text: Integrating custom software and modern AI into existing workflows needs a careful approach to infrastructure. The goal is harmony between the systems you already run and the demands of modern web, mobile and cloud products.
Legacy databases hold key context. Connect them to modern APIs and AI and they become a lasting advantage.
The foundation of modern software
Modernisation starts with treating data as your most valuable asset. Our first job is the connective tissue: robust middleware and fast APIs that process and deliver data wherever it's needed.
Clean schemas:
Transforming scattered formats into unified, well-typed schemas.
Low latency:
Tuning server pipelines for fast data delivery.
Data security:
Encrypting sensitive information and enforcing strict access controls.
Custom vs. off-the-shelf

Off-the-shelf tools are a fine start, but a platform engineered for your domain will outperform generic SaaS on speed, reliability and long-term cost: leaner code, smaller cloud bills and more predictable behaviour.
Human-in-the-loop by design

Automation shouldn't be all-or-nothing. We roll out progressive levels of control: early on, systems make recommendations your team validates; as confidence grows, they take on more of the routine work.
Looking ahead
The final step is moving from reactive maintenance to proactive systems that scale before traffic spikes and catch anomalies before users notice. That's the standard we build to at Jomiez Innovation.

faq.sub: Answers on how we scope, build and care for your product, and on the products we make ourselves.
faq.title: Everything you should know before we begin.

items.q: What does Jomiez make?
items.a: Two kinds of things. Our own products, like Chaka AI, a multimodal voice assistant, and Chaka WAP, an AI engine that lives inside WhatsApp. And custom software for businesses: websites, web and mobile apps, APIs and AI systems, with the design around them.

items.q: Are you taking on new projects?
items.a: Yes. The workshop is open to new builds. Tell us what you are growing and we will come back with scope, timeline and cost.

items.q: What tools and technologies do you use?
items.a: Mainly React, Node.js and Python for engineering, with Next.js and Framer on the front end and Figma for design. For AI work we build on Gemini, OpenAI and Claude.

items.q: Can we schedule a call to discuss a project?
items.a: Absolutely. Send us a few times that suit you and we will set up a call to walk through your project in detail.

items.q: Do you handle a project end to end?
items.a: Yes. From first sketch through design, development and launch, and in the seasons after: SEO, maintenance and continuous improvement.

story.label: Our story
story.title: From a single seed, a living company

paragraphs.text: We are Jomiez Innovation, a software company of engineers, designers and makers. We grow our own products and build for others with the same care: custom software, web and mobile applications and AI systems, from the interface down to the infrastructure beneath it.

The company is led by Emmanuel Ezinna Nweke, known as Templeton, our founder and lead engineer. He works in React, Next.js, Node.js and Python and builds AI on Gemini, OpenAI and Claude. That work took root in our own products: Chaka AI, a multimodal voice assistant, and Chaka WAP, a local-first AI engine that lives inside WhatsApp.
